name: opcua
title: OPC-UA: open62541 vs async-opcua
summary: Field-level differential + sanitizer fuzzing of OPC-UA binary decoding: open62541 (C, the most widely deployed industrial/SCADA stack, the target) against async-opcua (Rust). Each input is decoded as a top-level Variant by both stacks and re-encoded; because OPC-UA binary encoding is canonical, identical decoded values must re-encode to identical bytes, so a byte mismatch is a decoder bug with no cross-implementation type mapping. open62541 is built with ASan+UBSan+coverage; a memory-safety fault is the primary finding on this far-less-fuzzed target.
